service.description:
Systematic norm-to-product crosswalk (Phase 4): for a Product, resolve the technical requirements implied by its ProductCategory memberships (via the existing mantle-usl find#ProductFeatureGroups service and ProductFeatureGroupAppl), then check each required ProductFeature against the product's actual ProductFeatureAppl records. Reuses existing entities/services end to end; no new crosswalk entity.
This is a MmtCodeDefinedFunction MathModel (MM_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_COMPLIANCE, see CyberMachineGraphMetadataSeedData.xml): every call is logged as a moqui.math.MathModelRun (parameters/results as JSON, per the same run-tracking pattern any calculated result in this project should use instead of a bespoke result-tracking entity).
